deploy-bot: kicking off config-only canary 1728303030 -> altering timeout/batch/routing params for a small slice. details: routing.strategy=latency-aware, weight=0.04, batch_window_ms=25, max_batch_tokens=1200, per_request_timeout_ms=2000, change_window=25m

Priya: oncall here. will watch p50/p95/p99 and errors. starting trace sampling 100% for canary window.

Carlos: adding note 12: please ensure model variants untouched. set routing.pin=stable-2026-02 for this canary. No model swaps.

Lina: putting these alert thresholds: p99 > 380ms for 3m OR 5xx rate > 0.7% -> @infra-ops oncall page and auto-dry-run rollback. Will paste queries.

infra-ops: ack. creating canary id canary-1728303030. dashboard link: http://internal.metrics/canary-1728303030.

Sam: quick checklist from release playbook: pin applied, alerts wired, traces on, sample capture enabled. Also create a small synthetic load to exercise long-tail.

Priya: synthetic load running: `tools/loadgen -t inference -q 10 -d 3m --target canary-1728303030`

deploy-bot: CANARY LIVE at 4% traffic. Will emit updates at +8m and +20m. If rollback triggers hit, will drop to 0 and post runbook.

Carlos: posting rollback runbook snippet for convenience:

```
# revert config in infra
infractl deploy revert --env prod --group canary-1728303030 --to-config-id config-1728240000
# console: Releases -> canary-1728303030 -> Revert
```

Lina: attached alert queries: metric=inference.responses.5xx_rate window=3m eval>0.007; metric=inference.latency.p99 window=3m eval>0.38s. Pager and DM routes configured.

Priya: note: kv-cache hitrate should remain > 0.85. small batch windows can lower hitrate; watch heatmap.

infra-ops: update @1728303290 -> metrics: 5xx=0.18%, p99=340ms, kv_cache=0.87. No auto rollback. continuing to monitor.

Sam: reassigning follow-ups: Carlos will shadow resource metrics, Lina monitors errors, Priya handles traces + synthetic.

Priya: collecting 10 trace samples for post-mortem, also capturing 20 example requests that followed new routing path. command: `trace-capture --group canary-1728303030 --samples 10 --examples 20`

Carlos: if CPU or GPU memory spikes on any host, we'll reduce routing.weight to 0 immediately and throttle batch_window back to 50ms.

(No objections in thread)

deploy-bot: at +20m -> bumping to 18% (canary-1728303030). Observing for 30m before broader rollout. release note draft: "Config-only: tightened per-request timeout and narrower batch window; enabled latency-aware routing to reduce tail latency."

Lina: will keep alert sensitivity for the next hour. Ping me if you want to fast-track.

Priya: staying on until full rollout. thanks all. :coffee:
